messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: GPU autoscaling degraded — custom metrics pipeline delayed (prometheus adapter). Paging oncall.

incident-bot: alert: hpa/custom-metrics-scrape-latency > 3m for 2 clusters; affected: gpu-pool-prod, gpu-pool-batch. Estimated queue growth ongoing.

sara (oncall): on it. seeing burst of queued jobs and >90% throttle on gpu-pool-prod from last 5m. links: https://grafana.internal/r/dash/gpu-queues

mike (infra): I can confirm prometheus adapter scrape lag spiking ~00:07 UTC, adapter logs show 504s to prometheus-write, prom write queue growing.

ali (mlops): HPA is reading custom metrics via adapter, if adapter drops it returns no metrics => no scale up. suspecting write latency to tsdb.

carlos (sre): any customer-facing errors? pinging support.

emily (support): we have 2 customer reports of timeouts on /v1/generate starting ~00:12 UTC. customers A and B experiencing 503s and queued inference requests.

sara (oncall): severity: P1 for impact to hosted customers. Initiating live mitigation plan. First step: open canary capacity in fallback pool.

mike (infra): standing by. I can trigger quick scale on dedicated-spare pool and re-route traffic. Command: ``kubectl -n infra scale deployment gpu-fallback --replicas=6``

ali (mlops): also we can temporarily lower HPA threshold to force scale. Patch: ``kubectl patch hpa gpu-llm -p '{"spec":{"metrics":[{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","targetAverageUtilization":30}}]}}'``. That will create CPU-based fallback scaling.

sara (oncall): do both. mike: spin fallback. ali: apply HPA patch. I'll coordinate customer comms and keep pager updates.

mike (infra): fallback scaled, pods entering Ready. routing rule applied to send 20% traffic to gpu-fallback. infra-bot: deploy done (build 3f2a).

carlos (sre): monitoring queue length down 18% in 3m. latency tail improving.

emily (support): telling customers A/B we're mitigating, ETA 10-15m. They've acknowledged.

ali (mlops): applied CPU fallback HPA. Note: this is a stopgap — still investigating adapter root cause. Adapter logs show retransmit errors to prom at 00:06:12: ``error POST /write 504: upstream timeout``.

mike (infra): check network egress to TSDB region - there was a transient routing flap in egress-gw-2 at 00:05 UTC. I'm throttling retries and bumping connection pool.

sara (oncall): good. next: reduce client-side concurrency for hosted API to protect pool (rate limit). Can we flip feature flag?

mike (infra): flipping flag for burst_throttle on edge. infra-bot: feature flag toggled: burst_throttle=true.

carlos (sre): after throttle and fallback routing, overall token throughput stable and error rate dropping. queue growth stopped.

emily (support): customers reporting recovery: A: degraded but working; B: green.

ali (mlops): long-term: we'll add a metrics adapter retry budget, increase Prom write timeout, and add a pull path fallback to metrics-server for HPA. Filing follow-up ticket.

sara (oncall): handoff: i'm handing to mike for mitigation cleanup and investigation. mike, please take post-incident ownership for next 24h. I'll update incident doc and escalate to oncall rotation if needed.

mike (infra): taking it. I'll keep watch and collect logs (adapter, egress-gw, prom).

carlos (sre): brief postmortem notes: cause: egress routing flap -> prom write 504s -> adapter failed to return custom metrics -> HPA didn't scale -> GPU pools starved -> queue growth and throttling -> customer errors. Mitigations: fallback pool, CPU-based HPA fallback, edge burst throttle.

ali (mlops): adding conseq: add k8s probe around custom metrics adapter to provide health endpoint and trigger failover earlier.

sara (oncall): incident status: mitigated at 5175002299. last_message_ts set to 5175002350. Will open formal incident writeup and postmortem in #postmortems with links to dashboards and logs.

incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty incident PD-84321 acknowledged by sara (oncall).

mike (infra): logs collected: ``s3://redwood-logs/incidents/5175001234/``. I'll attach timeline and root-cause analysis to the ticket.

emily (support): closing customer comms loop. will follow up with account teams. :white_check_mark: 

sara (oncall): thanks team. moving to follow-up. please add any action items to the incident board. :pray:
